description:
Details of how the operator would be providing position reports

monitoring.monitorlib.clients.flight_planning.flight_info.PositionReportingDetails, as defined in monitoring/monitorlib/clients/flight_planning/flight_info.py

$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

max_missing_position_data_period.description: The max time elapsed in seconds, since last position, after which the flight should be considered nonconforming

position_frequency.description: Frequency, in hertz, at which the operator will send the flight position reports to the USS.
